values.VASP_PARTITION: Slurm partition VASP CPU jobs run in
values.VASP_CORES_PER_NODE: cores per node there; a full-node layout R x T has R * T equal to this
values.VASP_DEFAULT_LAYOUT: R x T launch_plan returns when no VASP timing is recorded yet, e.g. 48x1 (pure MPI: most VASP builds have no OpenMP)
values.VASP_SRUN_MPI: srun flag selecting the MPI plugin the VASP build needs, e.g. --mpi=pmi2, or an empty string when none is needed
values.VASP_LAUNCH: launch_plan's job-spec templates: {pre_launch, launcher, environment}, with {R} ranks/node, {T} threads/rank, {N} nodes, {env_script} and other values by name
